high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation about cyclones, specifically focusing on depressions. The slide is divided into two main sections: a textual explanation on the left and a map of the Indian Ocean region on the right. Title: "Depression:- a weak, early-stage cyclone or a baby cyclone." Text: "To create a cyclone we need:" Air pressure has to drop at one place. Wind has to gain momentum. Clouds have to gather. Rainfall occurs.
